arguments.question: For NVDA over 21/63 sessions, use the latest FOMC statement/projections and official monetary-policy materials to identify the current policy stance and the specific channels by which policy/financial conditions could affect AI infrastructure spending or NVDA’s equity valuation. Distinguish documented policy facts from generic transmission inference; do not quantify NVDA exposure or a price effect unless primary evidence measures it. Stop after current official FOMC evidence and state whether the company–macro link is resolvable.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether monetary policy is a material, evidenced driver of NVDA relative to SPY/XLK or instead an unquantified cross-asset risk requiring a conditional or insufficient-evidence draft.
